2607.25970.title: Reinforcement Learning for Code Optimization
2607.25970.paper_summary: RL for code correctness is now established: have the model generate a program, run it against hidden test cases, and reward solutions that pass. Extending this to code optimization seems straightforward: just add execution time to the reward. But in practice, once timing drives the reward, small problems in measurement noise, reward sparsity, or GRPO instability overwhelm the signal and make RL fail: generated solutions are barely faster, and more of them can fail. We make execution time learnable through three stages: (1) how code is tested, by building DMC-Optim with large optimization tests and a calibrated sandbox; (2) how speed is turned into reward, by composing correctness and speed in the RL environment and using an offline simulator to predict the most promising configurations; and (3) how the model learns from that reward, by adapting GRPO and evaluation to the sparser, noisier timed-execution setting. On DMC-Optim, the strongest optimization-aware configurations improve strict top-50% pass@1 from 18.0% to 31.3% on Qwen 2.5 7B and from 30.7% to 50.4% on CWM 32B. These gains further increase at stricter percentiles such as top-30%, with 125% relative improvement for CWM 32B, while preserving pure-correctness scores. When the timing sandbox is degraded, robust optimization RL reaches 100% to 200% improvement over standard RLVR, depending on the evaluation criterion. On LCB, CWM 32B wins up to 83% of median-sample speed comparisons against standard RLVR. Relative to the fastest correct human submissions per problem, it reaches about half the human rate of complexity-class improvements (14% vs. 28%).
2607.25970.paper_summary_zh: RL 用於程式正確性現在已經確立：讓模型生成一個程式，並在隱藏測試案例上運行，對通過的解決方案給予獎勵。將這擴展到程式優化似乎很簡單：只需將執行時間添加到獎勵中。但在實踐中，一旦時間驅動獎勵，測量噪音、小獎勵稀疏或 GRPO 不穩定性的小問題就會淹沒信號，使 RL 失敗：生成的解決方案幾乎沒有更快，並且更多的解決方案可能會失敗。我們通過三個階段使執行時間可學習：（1）如何測試程式，通過構建 DMC-Optim 進行大型優化測試和經過校準的沙盒；（2）如何將速度轉化為獎勵，通過在 RL 環境中組合正確性和速度，並使用離線模擬器預測最有前景的配置；以及（3）模型如何從該獎勵中學習，通過調整 GRPO 和評估以適應更稀疏、更嘈雜的計時執行設置。在 DMC-Optim 上，最強的優化感知配置將嚴格的前 50% pass@1 從 18.0% 提高到 31.3%（在 Qwen 2.5 7B 上），並將其從 30.7% 提高到 50.4%（在 CWM 32B 上）。這些增益在更嚴格的百分位數（如前 30%）進一步增加，CWM 32B 的相對改善達到 125%，同時保持純正確性分數。當計時沙盒降級時，穩健的優化 RL 在標準 RLVR 上達到 100% 到 200% 的改善，具體取決於評估標準。在 LCB 上，CWM 32B 在與標準 RLVR 的中位樣本速度比較中贏得了高達 83% 的勝率。相對於每個問題中最快的正確人類提交，它達到了約一半的人類複雜度類別改善率（14% 對 28%）。
